HCI education reflects the continual evolution of HCI, embracing the changing landscapes of technology, infrastructure, and technology use. This forum aims to provide a platform for HCI educators, practitioners, researchers, and students to share their perspectives, reflections, and experiences related to HCI education.
            --- Sukeshini Grandhi, Editor

result.paraphrase:
HCI education mirrors HCI’s ongoing evolution, taking in the shifting landscapes of technology, infrastructure, and how technology is used. This forum seeks to offer HCI educators, practitioners, researchers, and students a platform to share their perspectives, reflections, and experiences on HCI education.
--- Sukeshini Grandhi, Editor
